name: Contract permission missing from manifest uses

match.messagePattern: permission not declared in manifest uses: ([a-z][a-z0-9-]*)

proposal.explanation: The module contract declares permission "${permission}" but the manifest uses array does not carry it. Canon (21 healthy modules at distillation time) declares contract permissions inside manifest uses. Proposed repair: append "${permission}" to the uses array of the module manifest, changing nothing else.

lineage.verifiedBy: 41 manifests repaired with this exact operation; hub/module-contract-verifier.js then reported 101/101 contracts pass; Technical Glasses fingerprint moved 64fe833094caf20c -> dd4190de4908dc09 with HIGH seams cleared.
